network-localhost-url.problem: Your code contains a hardcoded URL pointing to localhost, 127.0.0.1, 0.0.0.0, or a private IP. This works on your machine but fails everywhere else — staging, production, teammates' setups, or CI runners.
network-localhost-url.impact: The request will fail in any environment that isn't yours: connection refused, name resolution error, or worse, hitting an unintended local service. In production, errors may be silent and only surface when users complain.
network-localhost-url.fix: Move the URL to an environment variable or config file (e.g. os.environ['API_URL']) and provide a sensible default for local dev. Keep your real production URL out of source control.
